verses.text: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
lines: God, why have you rejected us forever?
Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

verses.text: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.
lines: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old,
which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance:
Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

verses.text: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
lines: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins,
all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

verses.text: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.
lines: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly.
They have set up their standards as signs.

verses.text: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
lines: They behaved like men wielding axes,
cutting through a thicket of trees.

verses.text: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
lines: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

verses.text: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.
lines: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground.
They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

verses.text: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.
lines: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.”
They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

verses.text: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
lines: We see no miraculous signs.
There is no longer any prophet,
neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

verses.text: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
lines: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach?
Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

verses.text: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
lines: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand?
Take it from your chest and consume them!

verses.text: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.
lines: Yet God is my King of old,
working salvation throughout the earth.

verses.text: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
lines: You divided the sea by your strength.
You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

verses.text: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
lines: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces.
You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

verses.text: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
lines: You opened up spring and stream.
You dried up mighty rivers.

verses.text: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
lines: The day is yours, the night is also yours.
You have prepared the light and the sun.

verses.text: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
lines: You have set all the boundaries of the earth.
You have made summer and winter.

verses.text: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
lines: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh.
Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

verses.text: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.
lines: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts.
Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.

verses.text: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.
lines: Honor your covenant,
for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

verses.text: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.
lines: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed.
Let the poor and needy praise your name.

verses.text: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.
lines: Arise, God! Plead your own cause.
Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

verses.text: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
lines: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries.
The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
